output.rationale: Start with a compact WWI cause-and-timeline model, then require the learner to explain it back and repair gaps. This fits a novice learner who wants the big picture first and benefits from a concrete example and step-by-step pacing.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions split Europe into rival blocs and raised the chance that a local crisis could spread.
The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis, then alliances and mobilization turned that crisis into declarations of war.
From 1914 to 1918 the war moved from outbreak to U.S. entry and ended with the armistice.
completionEvidence: Name the main alliance blocs and at least three prewar tensions.
Put Sarajevo, the July Crisis, the start of the war, U.S. entry, and the armistice in order.
Classify each key item as a cause, event, or consequence.

methodBriefing.name: Feynman Technique
methodBriefing.what: Study a concise model, explain it in your own words, repair any gap, then explain it again.
methodBriefing.why: Explaining and repairing helps turn a new history topic into a connected cause and timeline story.
how: Read or view one concise model.
Explain the idea from memory in plain language.
Compare your explanation with the model and fix missing or unclear parts.
Explain it again without copying the model.
methodBriefing.completion: You complete the cycle by producing a correct explanation, repairing one gap, and reexplaining it more clearly.
personalization: Use the concrete example to anchor the first explanation.
Keep each step small and explicit.
Leave a delay before the final retrieval check.

activities.label: Big picture map
activities.title: WWI cause map overview
activities.body: Read the model and note the three parts. Then say what each part is in one phrase.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions split Europe into rival blocs and raised the chance that a local crisis could spread.
The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis, then alliances and mobilization turned that crisis into declarations of war.

activities.label: Explain the chain
activities.title: From Sarajevo to war
activities.body: Explain the chain in your own words. Keep it short and use the model as your guide.
activities.concept: Sequence from the Sarajevo assassination to declarations of war
activities.correctAnswer: The Sarajevo assassination started the July Crisis, and then alliance commitments and mobilization led to declarations of war.
activities.feedback: A complete answer shows the cause to crisis to war sequence and names the role of alliances or mobilization.

activities.label: Fix the sequence
activities.title: Repair the cause chain
activities.body: Use the hint to correct your answer. Then give one revised version of the sequence.
activities.misconceptionSummary: The assassination by itself was the war; nothing else in the July Crisis mattered.
activities.concept: Sequence from the Sarajevo assassination to declarations of war
activities.correctAnswer: The assassination did not by itself become a world war; the July Crisis, alliance commitments, and mobilization helped turn it into declarations of war.
activities.feedback: This repair separates the spark from the wider escalation process and shows why the crisis widened.

activities.label: Timeline from memory
activities.title: WWI 1914 to 1918
activities.body: Explain the timeline from memory. Include the start, U.S. entry, and the armistice.
activities.correctAnswer: World War I began in 1914, the United States entered in 1917, and the war ended with the armistice in 1918.
activities.feedback: A complete answer puts the main dates in order and identifies what each date represents.

activities.label: Final check
activities.title: Choose the best timeline
activities.body: Pick the option that best matches the basic WWI timeline.
activities.feedback: This checks the start, midpoint, and ending of the war in the correct order.

items.essentialIdea: Prewar European alliances and tensions linked rival powers through opposing alliance blocs.

check.title: Rival Blocs in Europe
check.prompt: How did prewar European alliances shape tensions among the major powers?
check.referenceAnswer: Europe was divided into rival alliance blocs, which linked states together and made a local crisis more dangerous. These alliances increased suspicion and encouraged powers to support their allies.
check.feedback: The key point is that alliances turned rivalry into bloc competition, not just isolated disputes.

items.essentialIdea: The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis and then rapid declarations of war.

check.title: From Assassination to War
check.prompt: What happened after the Sarajevo assassination that led toward war?
check.referenceAnswer: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo set off the July Crisis, and tensions quickly escalated into declarations of war by major powers.
check.feedback: Focus on the immediate chain from assassination to crisis to war declarations.

check.title: World War I Timeline
check.prompt: What is the basic chronological span of World War I, and what marks its end?

check.feedback: The timeline runs from outbreak in 1914 to the armistice in 1918.
